steps.title: Play together
steps.intro: Produced by tools/render_jobs/jobs/play_together.json with probes/ui_play_together.gd: the title's Play together card (PlayTogetherCard) and Resume (ResumeEntry) at 1280x720 (Auto 1.40) and 1920x1080 window sizes, in the morning and dusk moods (a staged library of sample maps; no level is written). The card's states are set as its own input sets them (hover picks a face without moving the OS cursor); the press, the flood and Join's opening are held part way for filmstrips (no room is asked for); the saved sessions Resume lists are staged (nothing is written to user://sessions/); the join failures are shown as Root's SessionFlow reports them. After rest and each hover the faces' words are hidden for a frame and the contrast step logs paper against the lightest wash pixel under them. room_resumed and room_missing are the GM's room staged after Resume with a changed and a missing map (probes/ui_room.gd).
